sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 3 October 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000114-P1 was put before Desert Bloom Family Clinic 114 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 3.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Pneumococcal preferred-position minimum of 90 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer has not yet responded.
